focus: D1 correctness - spec-kit retrieval and trigger index

findingDetails.title: The v4.0.0.3 release shipped with a trigger index stale for its own changelog entry
findingDetails.evidence: Last in-range index commit 903c983c39; six later commits rewrote the changelog phrases and no rebuild followed; index blob at the tag equals HEAD (6dfeb68c81); --check exits 1 with the changelog stale; executed lookups show the current phrase misses the entry while the stale phrase hits it at score 1.0; CI check is continue-on-error.
findingDetails.recommendation: Regenerate the trigger index from the tagged content as part of the release tail, and rebuild it in the same commit as any changelog phrase change so --check stays green.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Compared the tagged index blob with HEAD's, listed index and changelog commits in range, ran --check (exit 1) and both phrase lookups; packet-doc staleness excluded as branch-local.
